text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's Epiphaneia!
Don't worry, Trainer.
Just follow me and everything'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Destiny" loves me!
And as proof, I can hear it—the "Voice of Destiny"
backing up every choice I make!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"So, let's go!
Once they see my race,
I'm sure everyone will be granted their 'destiny'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
